description:
Stand Out With Durable Plastic Business Cards


Make a stronger impression with plastic business cards that feel different the moment they’re handed over. These tear-proof, waterproof cards are built to last, making them perfect for salons, spas, restaurants, gyms, and any industry where cards are frequently handled. Choose from clear, frosted, or white plastic to match your brand’s style and give your business card a premium, modern edge.

Sturdy, Stylish, and Built to Last

Plastic Material Options
Standard Sizing and Shape
Tearproof and Waterproof
Clear for a bold, transparent look US standard 2" x 3.5" size and Euro 2.125” x 3.375” Printed on sturdy 20 pt. plastic
Frosted for a semi-opaque modern finish Rectangle and oval shapes available Resistant to rips, smudges, and water exposure
White for bright, high-contrast designs Rounded corners optional in 1/8" or 1/4" Ideal for daily handling and long-term use

Flexible Options for Every Finish



Choose Your Finish

Clear for transparency, frosted for a sleek matte look, or white for bold and colorful layouts.

Print on One or Both Sides

Add logos, contact info, and imagery with full-color printing available front and back.

Add Rounded Corners

Available in two corner radius sizes for a polished, premium finish.

Create Online or Upload a File

Use our easy online design tool or upload a press-ready file with your final artwork.

Design Tips Provided

Get best practices for font size, color contrast, and layout visibility based on plastic type.


Plastic Business Cards FAQs

Our plastic is best utilized in a business card format, so your information stands out against traditional materials such as paper and card stock. We cannot add magnetic strips, sequential numbering, or apply variable printing to your orders.

Our 20 pt. material is slightly thinner than a credit card but just as durable thanks to its tear-proof and waterproof qualities. It is guaranteed to last years and won't get destroyed as long as your customers keep the plastic business card. 

All white areas in your design will blend with the plastic appearance. This means white ink will appear transparent on a clear card, frosted on a semi-transparent one, and white on the opaque white material.

It's important to keep several design principles in mind. Make sure the information and images don't appear cluttered. Use colors and fonts that are easy to read. We recommend having a professional design your card or you could use our online design tool to guide you. You can request for a free file check to be sure it is free from printing errors before proceeding to print.
